question: Is animating another body the same as transmitting a knowledge lineage?
premises: A yogi may animate another body by will, like entering a corpse.
Such animation does not establish the same kind of continuity as a knowledge lineage.
The yogi's own body is not abandoned in that process.
inference: The transmission of a knowledge lineage is not equivalent to a yogi's temporary animation of another body.
plain_english: It is not the same as a yogi animating a corpse-body by will; when a yogi brings life to another body and so on, that does not create the same kind of continuity, since the yogi does not abandon his own body.
